content.short: HyperSwap is a concentrated liquidity AMM and one of the principal exchanges on HyperEVM.
content.description: HyperSwap runs concentrated liquidity pools on HyperEVM and is among the most used exchanges on the chain, making it a common routing hop for aggregators. Each new EVM chain tends to produce one or two native AMMs that capture the bulk of early liquidity before the established multi-chain names arrive, and HyperSwap occupies that position on HyperEVM.
